# Selawik

Microsoft's open source replacement for Segoe UI. Distributed under SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see LICENSE.txt).

- Font source: https://github.com/microsoft/Selawik
- Compiled original font files: https://github.com/microsoft/MRDL_Unity_PeriodicTable/tree/master/Assets/MRDL_PeriodicTable/Fonts
- Files: selawk.ttf (Regular), selawksb.ttf (Semibold), retrieved 2026-10-05 without modification.

The assistant uses Segoe UI where installed and these bundled fonts on macOS. Selawik's kerning and rasterization differ from Segoe UI; platform-specific text rendering can affect line breaks.
